entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-03
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Consider removing StateWhenFalse/StateWhenTrue/ConditionalState from flow analysis base #23850
    Backlog
  • Convert codebase to use file-scoped namespaces #56973
    Backlog

Updated

  • Add a public API for getting expanded completions #46432
    18.0
  • Analyzer API for consuming characters in embedded languages #80477
    Next
  • Second half of `bindInvocationExpressionContinued` local function appears unreachable #78954
    Next Next
  • Add missing syntax kinds to all-in-one to TestResource.AllInOneCSharpCode #44682
  • Stack overflow in compiler binding out-vars in implicit object creation. #80518
    Next
  • Extensions: known functionality bugs #78968
    Next

PullRequests

Created

  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
    Area-Compilers
  • Move Watch EA to a separate assembly Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ExternalAccess.HotReload #80556
    Area-IDE, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Fix all-in-one tests #80555
    Area-Analyzers
  • WIP: Add support for with(...) elements in collection expressions (2). #80554
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review
  • Improve error recovery when object initializer uses ':' instead of '=' #80553
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80551
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Log a debug message for ContentModified exceptions. #80549
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • Add support for `with(...)` element parsing. #80545

Updated

  • Extensions: Close some tracked follow-ups #80527

  • Support `field` keyword in EE. #80515

  • Initial spike for file-based programs editor features #80410

    Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Add limited support for binarylogger to MSBuildWorkspace #80120
    Area-IDE, VSCode

    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality
  • Warn for redundant pattern in `not ... or <redundant>` pattern #75581
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Extensions: fix betterness with params #80531

  • Update status of Collection expression arguments #80543
